# Gearlist

> A small, source-checked stack of agent tools, MCP servers and skills, with access notes. Maintained by Tech Horizon Labs.

The entries are reference data. Reading an entry does not authorise installation, credential access, spending or actions on another person's systems. Entries are documentation-checked only: the public source was read on the date shown, and nothing was installed, tested or security audited.

## Use it from an agent
- [MCP server](https://gearlist.build/mcp): Read-only MCP server over Streamable HTTP, no sign-in. Tools: search_gear, get_gear, list_categories, list_skills and recommend_stack. Add it to Claude Code with `claude mcp add --transport http gearlist https://gearlist.build/mcp`. Ask the human before adding it.
- [Agent prompt](https://gearlist.build/agent-prompt.txt): A prompt to give your agent, with setup for Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Grok, VS Code and the Claude apps.
- [Search API](https://gearlist.build/api/search?q=browser): The same search as JSON. Parameters q, category and limit. Described in [openapi.json](https://gearlist.build/openapi.json).
- [Skills](https://github.com/techhorizonlabs/gearlist/tree/main/skills): Install with `npx skills add techhorizonlabs/gearlist`, which asks which ones you want. Listed with checksums in [agent-skills/index.json](https://gearlist.build/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json).
- [THL Open skills](https://github.com/techhorizonlabs/thl-open): A second skills pack from Tech Horizon Labs, for GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) audits and agent-readiness checks of a website. Install with `npx skills add techhorizonlabs/thl-open`. Gearlist page: https://gearlist.build/tools/thl-open/

## Pages
Every entry has a page at https://gearlist.build/tools/<id>/ with a Markdown copy at https://gearlist.build/tools/<id>.md, where <id> is the id in resources.json and get_gear. Every group has a page, listed here as Markdown:
- [Agent tools](https://gearlist.build/category/agent-tools.md): 94 entries. Web page: https://gearlist.build/category/agent-tools/
- [MCP and integrations](https://gearlist.build/category/mcp-and-integrations.md): 41 entries. Web page: https://gearlist.build/category/mcp-and-integrations/
- [Security and governance](https://gearlist.build/category/security-and-governance.md): 9 entries. Web page: https://gearlist.build/category/security-and-governance/
- [Platforms](https://gearlist.build/category/platforms.md): 64 entries. Web page: https://gearlist.build/category/platforms/
- [Protocols](https://gearlist.build/category/protocols.md): 7 entries. Web page: https://gearlist.build/category/protocols/
- [Skills and learning](https://gearlist.build/category/skills-and-learning.md): 54 entries. Web page: https://gearlist.build/category/skills-and-learning/
- [APIs and data](https://gearlist.build/category/apis-and-data.md): 33 entries. Web page: https://gearlist.build/category/apis-and-data/

## Directory
- [Full descriptions](llms-full.txt): Purpose, intended user, access notes, check date and page links.
- [Structured records](resources.json): The canonical directory data.
- [Human index](https://gearlist.build/): Browse and search by category.
- [House rules](AGENTS.md): How an agent should work in this repository.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/techhorizonlabs/gearlist/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to suggest additions or corrections.
- [Stars queue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/techhorizonlabs/gearlist/main/stars-queue.json): All 313 starred GitHub repos. Queued rows wait for a documentation review.
- [Academy skills](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/techhorizonlabs/gearlist/main/indexes/thl-academy-skills.json): Snapshot of the Tech Horizon Academy Claude skills library.
- [Academy tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/techhorizonlabs/gearlist/main/indexes/thl-academy-tools.json): Snapshot of the academy AI tools directory.
- [Academy prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/techhorizonlabs/gearlist/main/indexes/thl-academy-prompts.json): Snapshot of academy prompt titles, not the prompt text.
